candidate.title: Div-Seq
candidate.scope: Div-Seq as depicted in the assigned Illumina poster row: EdU-based enrichment of nuclei followed by nuclear RNA-to-cDNA conversion, amplification, tagmentation and indexed library preparation. The row is a schematic, ending at an enrichment-ready fragment. Neighboring inDrop, Nuc-Seq and SCRB-Seq rows and the small single-cell/poly(A)-RNA summary icon are contextual, not alternative target workflows or material branches. Nuc-Seq/modified Smart-Seq2 is a component of Div-Seq here, not an additional target. The matching catalogue page is secondary evidence and the Science paper resolves the EdU selection and single-nucleus expression interpretation; abstract-only preprint evidence does not establish all detailed implementation equivalences.
